name: United Nova Technology Co.,Ltd.
summary: United Nova Technology Co.,Ltd. is a global producer and supplier of power discrete components and modules, catering to both domestic Chinese and international markets. The company's comprehensive product portfolio features IGBTs, MOSFETs, analog integrated circuits (ICs), MEMS devices, and microcontrollers (MCUs). Beyond individual components, it delivers integrated system manufacturing solutions designed for critical sectors such as automotive, clean energy, industrial applications, and home appliances. Furthermore, United Nova Technology develops specialized products, including automotive-grade IGBT/SiC chips and modules, along with analog ICs crafted for high-voltage, mixed-signal applications. Established in 2018, the company initially operated as Semiconductor Manufacturing Electronics (Shaoxing) Corporation before officially changing its name to United Nova Technology Co.,Ltd. in November 2023. Its main office is situated in Shaoxing, China.
